labels.reason: Preamble ends with a sentence announcing a list of collected items that never follows (orphan sentence). Real drafting defect; severity should be Low/Medium.
Purpose 'legal obligations under related laws' names no law or duty; open-ended purpose.
Retention for the subscription-winner list ends at a named event (after eligibility screening). The rule accepts criteria when a fixed period cannot be set.

Rule-pack TP: procedure and method paragraphs exist (PIPA 30(1)3-2 met) but no step says who selects data for destruction and who approves it. The selection/approval detail is guideline-only; severity should be Medium, not High.

Rights list includes transmission; the policy states no automated decisions are made and gives a channel (website or privacy department) for all rights. Missing per-right menu paths is at most an R-S16-002 detail.
Recipient row lists four banks and ends with '등'; recipients must be named in full.
Purpose ends with '등 기타 편의 서비스'; open-ended.
Item list uses '등 기타 고객이 입력한' wording; items not concrete.

Rule-pack TP: procedure and method paragraphs exist (PIPA 30(1)3-2 met) but no step says who selects data for destruction and who approves it. The selection/approval detail is guideline-only; severity should be Medium, not High.

Core rights (access, correction/deletion, suspension) and a request channel are present. Gap is only 전송요구권 (PIPA 35-2; for private processors Decree 42-2(1)1 starts 2027-02-20) and 자동화된 결정 rights (PIPA 37-2; only if such decisions are made). Fact-dependent; rule-pack TP as written. Consent withdrawal is offered only via the withdrawal menu.
Quoted text is a summary label that points to the body ('세부 항목은 본문 확인'); the body table lists purposes without '등'.
